instagram-notify.description: The caged instagram.com page may post native unread-DM notifications. macOS only, and only the single notify command - remote pages get nothing else.

instagram-open-link.description: The caged instagram.com page may hand a link someone sent in a DM to the real browser. Links are marked target=_blank by Instagram, and a webview has no tabs, so without this they open nowhere. Only the single open-url command - remote pages get nothing else.
